# xmatters_people (Data Source)

Returns a list of people in xMatters that are visible to the authenticating user. You can request a list of users, or use the 'search' argument to return users that only match the specified criteria. When two or more search terms are present, the result includes people that match either search term.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// No filter is applied here returning all people
data "xmatters_people" "get_people_list" {
}

// Search for people by terms and fields
data "xmatters_people" "get_people_list_by_search" {
  search = {
    terms   = "Craig James"
    operand = "AND"
    fields = [
      "FIRST_NAME",
      "LAST_NAME"
    ]
  }
}

// Filters applied to limit returned devices 
data "xmatters_people" "get_people_list_by_filter" {
  filters = {
    created_from        = "2024-06-14T16:17:31.450Z"
    created_to          = "2025-01-14T22:25:43.290Z"
    devices_exists      = true
    devices_status      = "ACTIVE"
    devices_test_status = "TESTED"
  }
  options = {
    sort_by    = "FIRST_LAST_NAME"
    sort_order = "ASCENDING"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes) Search filters to improve the search results. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `options` (Attributes) Sorting options for search results. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--options))
- `search` (Attributes) Basic search parameters to find a list of xMatters users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--search))

### Read-Only

- `people` (Attributes List) List of available xMatters users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--people))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Optional:

- `created_after` (String) Timestamp in ISO format. Returns a list of users created up to and until the provided value. Can be used on its own or in conjunction with the ‘createdBefore’ and ‘createdTo’ parameters.
- `created_before` (String) Timestamp in ISO format. Returns a list of users created at or after the provided value. Can be used on its own or in conjunction with the ‘createdAfter’ and ‘createdFrom’ parameters.
- `created_from` (String) Timestamp in ISO format. Returns a list of users created after the provided value. Can be used on its own or in conjunction with the ‘createdBefore’ and ‘createdBefore’ parameters.
- `created_to` (String) Timestamp in ISO format. Returns a list of users created before the provided value. Can be used on its own or in conjunction with the ‘createdAfter’ and ‘createdFrom’ parameters.
- `devices_email_exists` (Boolean) If set to ‘true’, returns a list of users who have at least one failsafe device associated with their account. If set to ‘false’, returns users with no failsafe devices.
- `devices_exists` (Boolean) If set to ‘true’, returns a list of users who have at least one email device associated with their account. If set to ‘false’, returns users with no email devices.
- `devices_failsafe_exists` (Boolean) If set to ‘true’, returns a list of users who have at least one device with the xMatters mobile app associated with their account. If set to ‘false’, returns users who have no devices with the mobile app.
- `devices_mobile_exists` (Boolean) If set to ‘true’, returns a list of users who have at least one SMS device associated with their account. If set to ‘false’, returns users with no SMS devices.
- `devices_sms_exists` (Boolean) If set to ‘true’, returns a list of users who have at least one SMS device associated with their account. If set to ‘false’, returns users with no SMS devices.
- `devices_status` (String) Status of the user’s devices in xMatters. Returns the devices that match the specified status. Available options are: ACTIVE, INACTIVE.
- `devices_test_status` (String) Whether xMatters has attempted to validate the user’s devices or not. Returns a list of users with devices that match the requested value. Values can be combined in a comma-separated list. Available options are: INVALID, TESTED, UNTESTED, UNTESTED_FAILSAFE, PENDING.
- `devices_voice_exists` (Boolean) If set to ‘true’, returns a list of users who have at least one voice device associated with their account. If set to ‘false’, returns users with no voice devices.
- `email_address` (String) Email address of a user. Returns a list of users who have an email device with the provided value.
- `first_name` (String) First name of a user. Returns a list of users with the provided value.
- `groups` (List of String) Group target name (Base64-encoded) or unique ID. Returns a list of users who are direct members of the specified group. When multiple groups are specified, returns users who are members of at least one of the groups. Submit multiple values in a comma-separated list.
- `groups_exists` (Boolean) If set to ‘true’, returns a list of users who are members of at least one group. If set to ‘false’, returns users who are not members of any group.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of a user. Returns a list of users with the provided value.
- `license_type` (String) License type of a user. Returns a list of users with the provided value. Available options are: FULL_USER, STAKEHOLDER_USER.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number of a voice device. Returns a list of users who have a voice device with the specified phone number. Phone numbers must be in E.164 format. For example: 13065552241.
- `roles` (List of String) Names of roles in xMatters. Returns a list of users who have the specified roles. When multiple roles are specified, the response returns users who have at least one of the roles. Values can be combined in a comma-separated list. The spelling of a role name must be an exact match to the name in xMatters, but is not case-sensitive.
- `site` (String) Names or unique ID of sites in xMatters. Returns a list of users belonging to the specified site. Site names are case-sensitive.
- `status` (String) Status of a user. Returns users with the provided value. Available options are: ACTIVE, INACTIVE.
- `supervisors` (List of String) Names or unique IDs of user supervisors. Returns a list of users assigned to the specified supervisors. Values can be combined in a comma-separated list. When multiple supervisors are specified, the response returns users who are assigned to at least one of the supervisors.
- `supervisors_exists` (Boolean) If set to ‘true’, returns a list of users who are assigned to supervisors. If set to ‘false’, returns users who are not assigned to supervisors.
- `target_name` (String) User ID in xMatters. A combination of letters and numbers is permitted with a maximum value of 100 characters. For example, a target name for Mary McBride could be 'mmcbride' or 'mcbride2418'.
- `web_login` (String) Identifier used to log in to the xMatters web user interface. If a value is not set in the request, the value of the target_name field is used. This field has a maximum of 100 characters.


<a id="nestedatt--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options`

Optional:

- `sort_by` (String) Criteria for sorting the returned results. This parameter must be used together with the ‘sort_order’ query parameter. Available options are: FIRST_LAST_NAME, TARGET_NAME, STATUS, WEB_LOGIN, LAST_LOGIN, SITE, ROLES.
- `sort_order` (String) Order in which returned users are sorted. This parameter must be used together with the ‘sort_by’ query parameter. Available options are: ASCENDING, DESCENDING.


<a id="nestedatt--search"></a>
### Nested Schema for `search`

Optional:

- `fields` (List of String) Set the field to search when a search term is specified,. Available options are: FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, TARGET_NAME, WEB_LOGIN, EMAIL_ADDRESS, PHONE_NUMBER.
- `operand` (String) Operands expand or limit the search query parameter. OR is the default operand and returns services that have any of the search terms in the name or description. AND returns services that have all search terms in the name or description.
- `terms` (String) List of search terms, separated by spaces. Used with the operand and fields parameters to expand or limit search results. When two or more search terms are present, the result includes services that match either search term.


<a id="nestedatt--people"></a>
### Nested Schema for `people`

Read-Only:

- `external_key` (String) Unique identifier of the user in an external system.
- `externally_owned` (Boolean) Whether the user is managed by an external system.
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the xMatters user.
- `language` (String) Default language of the user.
- `last_login` (String)
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user.
- `license_type` (String) License type of the user in xMatters. Available options are: FULL_USER, STAKEHOLDER_USER.
- `phone_login` (String) Access code used to retrieve phone messages from xMatters.
- `roles` (Set of String) List of the user's assigned role names.
- `site` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the xMatters site the user is assigned to.
- `status` (String) Status of the user. Available options are: ACTIVE,  INACTIVE.
- `supervisors` (Set of String) List of unique identifiers (UUIDs) that represent the user's supervisors.
- `target_name` (String) User ID in xMatters consisting of a combination of letters and numbers up to 100 characters.
- `timezone` (String) Time zone where the user is located.
- `web_login` (String) Identifier used to log in to the xMatters user interface. This is often identical to the targetName value.
